councilQuote: This isn't just about nightlife; it's about connecting with the community where they are. We're breaking down the walls of City Hall.
influencerQuote: District {district} has some of the most vibrant, unsung spots in the city. I can't wait to show everyone what makes this neighborhood tick.

winner.summaryBody: We're excited to visit "where love & flavor meet" at Kajunlicious Food Therapy in Gentilly! With 41 votes from the community Kajunlicious will be the last stop of our nightcrawl in District D!

stops.title: {influencerName}'s Bayou Road Opener
stops.body: The night kicks off in {location} at a spot {influencerName} wants more people to know—local flavor, strong community ties, and the energy that keeps this corridor moving.
stops.runoffBody: Casey starts our night out with community, conversation and cocktails at Whiskey & Sticks, along New Orleans' historic Bayou Road.

stops.title: {councilName}'s Lakeside Classic
stops.body: Stop two is Councilmember {councilName}'s pick: a lakefront institution where longtime residents and newcomers can share a table and talk about what the ward needs next.
stops.runoffBody: Councilmember Green's stop is on District D's majestic lakefront, at Landry's Seafood House, where the beautiful scenery matches the tastes and refreshments.

stops.title: The District D Vote
stops.body: Vote for the venue that should close out the crawl. The winner in {location} becomes our third stop when District D hits the street on August 13.
